info.title: API: Experiences
info.description: The Experiences API lets you search tours and activities, check availability, reviews, and booking options. Discovery endpoints proxy to experiences-api. Access requires `experiences_access` on your account.

tags.name: Experiences
tags.description: Search tours, check availability, reviews, and booking options for tours and activities.

prebookId.description: Dispatcher prebook session that created this booking.

price.description: Partner sell price charged via Stripe / persisted on the booking. Not GYG retail. Public responses omit providerPayment.

commission.description: Partner earn on this booking (sell − commercial net). Same value as clientCommission until experiences distributor markup exists.

clientCommission.description: Partner earn on this booking (sell − commercial net). Hotel-parity field name.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this booking.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the slot price.

numberOfParticipants.description: Count of participants in this category.

dateTime.description: Chosen slot start time from booking-options (`slots[].dateTime`).

value.description: Answer value. Type depends on the question: string for text/select, integer for date components, object for grouped fields like pickup_location.

language.description: ISO language code used for validate and downstream book cart.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code used for validate and downstream book cart.

clientReferenceId.description: Partner reference echoed in prebook response and stored on the checkout session.

dateTime.description: Chosen slot start time from the prebook selection.

experienceBookingId.description: Experiences-api internal booking uuid from validate.

providerBookingId.description: Provider booking hash from validate (`bookingId` upstream).

transactionId.description: Stripe PaymentIntent transaction id. Confirm with Stripe SDK, then pass to book.

secretKey.description: Stripe client secret for PaymentIntent confirmation.

publishableKey.description: Stripe publishable key when returned by payment-gateway.

reservationExpiresAt.description: UTC expiry of the validate hold (~10 minutes). Create a new prebook after expiry.

paymentTypes.description: Supported payment methods for book. Phase 1: `TRANSACTION_ID` only.

method.description: Phase 1 supports Stripe capture via `TRANSACTION_ID` only.

transactionId.description: Stripe transaction id from prebook. Omit to use the id stored on the prebook session.

customTags.description: Optional bag of up to 5 user-defined key/value labels persisted with the booking. Keys must match `^[A-Z0-9_-]+$`; values are strings up to 255 characters.

description.description: Additional error context. Prebook requests can relay canonical booking validation details.

key.description: Dot-path to the offending field in the request body, present on field-level validation errors (e.g. `bodyRequest.selection.price.amount`).

unitNet.description: Partner-facing sell per unit (commercial net marked up in place). unitNet × quantity may differ from totalNet by a cent.

totalNet.description: Partner-facing sell for the line. Sum of totalNet reconciles to totals.net.

unitNet.description: Partner-facing sell per unit (commercial net marked up in place).

totalNet.description: Partner-facing sell for the group ticket line.

unitNet.description: Partner-facing sell per additional pax (commercial net marked up in place).

totalNet.description: Partner-facing sell for the additional-pax line.

unitNet.description: Partner-facing sell per addon unit (commercial net marked up in place).

totalNet.description: Partner-facing sell for the addon line.

net.description: Authoritative slot sell total after partner markup. Use as selection.price.amount on prebook.

commission.description: Partner earn on this slot (sell − commercial net). Present when experience markup is configured.

netPrice.description: Slot sell total (same semantics as totals.net after markup). Replaces the former retailPrice field name.

ExperienceSlotPricing.description: Slot money fields are partner-facing sell amounts (commercial net marked up in place). Provider retail is not returned.

unavailabilityReason.description: Why the slot is unavailable when isAvailable is false. Official GetYourGuide groups: no_availability, not_enough_spots, invalid_request, others. Legacy responses may also include sold_out.

minParticipants.description: Minimum participants required for this slot; present even when unavailable.

maxParticipants.description: Maximum participants allowed for this slot.

language.description: ISO language code for localized content.

participants.description: Participant counts keyed by ticket category (age band), e.g. `adult`, `child`. Keys are lowercase and must match a `ticketCategory` returned by `GET /experiences/tours/{id}/availability` for this tour. An array (e.g. `[{"category":"adult","count":2}]`) is rejected, and uppercase keys (e.g. `ADULT`) are rejected - use the exact lowercase category strings from availability.

additionalProperties.description: Number of participants in this category.

addons.description: Optional add-ons to price alongside the tour, from `GET .../availability` `addons[].id`.

TourDealSummaryResponse.description: Present only when a promotional deal applies to the tour's from-price.

description.example: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the experience starts

cancellationFeeUnitOffsetMin.description: Minutes before start time the fee schedule above applies.

TourItineraryResponse.description: One day (or the only day) of a structured itinerary. Empty `itineraries` on the tour means the provider has no structured itinerary data.

TourBaseResponse.description: Shared tour fields returned by both search listings and the detail endpoint.

description.example: A guided morning tour with skip-the-line access.

TourSummaryResponse.description: Tour listing as returned by tour search. The list mapper collapses `notSuitableFor` to a single string. Use `GET /experiences/tours/{id}` for the full detail payload including `itineraries`.

notSuitableFor.description: First suitability restriction from the provider, collapsed to a single string by the list mapper.

TourDetailResponse.description: Full tour detail including structured itineraries.

notSuitableFor.description: Individual suitability restrictions from the provider.

itineraries.description: Ordered structured itinerary. Empty when the provider has no structured itinerary data.

independentlyBookable.description: Whether this category can be booked without an adult present.

share.description: Fraction of total reviews at this rating, 0-1.

comment.example: Our guide was fantastic and skip-the-line saved us hours.

get.description:
## Overview

Search available tours and activities with localized content and prices in your chosen currency.

## When to Use

- **Search results** - Populate a tours listing or map view
- **Destination pages** - Show activities available in a city or region
- **Category browsing** - Filter tours by type, duration, or rating

## What You Get

- **Tour listings** - Titles, descriptions, images, and ratings
- **Localized content** - Names and descriptions in the requested language
- **Prices** - Amounts in the requested currency

## Quick Start

Provide required `language` and `currency` query parameters. Returns a paginated list of matching tours.

tours.title: Skip-the-line morning tour
tours.description: A guided morning tour with skip-the-line access.

cancellationPolicy.description: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the experience starts

get.description:
## Overview

Retrieve full details for a specific tour, including description, media, inclusions, pricing context, and structured itineraries when available.

## When to Use

- **Product pages** - Display a tour detail view before the user selects dates
- **Comparison** - Show full metadata when comparing activities
- **Content enrichment** - Fetch descriptions and images for marketing surfaces

## What You Get

- **Complete tour profile** - Title, description, duration, and highlights
- **Media** - Images and cover assets
- **Practical info** - Meeting points, cancellation policy, and inclusions
- **Structured itineraries** - Ordered days/items (`itineraries`) when the provider supplies them. `locations` are importance-ordered tags, not itinerary order.
- **Localized pricing** - Prices in the requested currency

## Quick Start

Provide the tour `id` in the URL path plus required `language` and `currency` query parameters.

data.description: A guided morning tour with skip-the-line access.

get.description:
## Overview

Retrieve available dates and time slots for a specific tour so users can pick when to attend.

## When to Use

- **Date pickers** - Populate a calendar or slot selector on the tour page
- **Availability checks** - Confirm a tour runs on the user's travel dates
- **Booking flow** - Gate the checkout path until a valid slot is selected

## What You Get

- **Available dates** - Days the tour can be booked
- **Time slots** - Start times per date where applicable
- **Capacity hints** - Whether slots are still bookable

## Quick Start

Provide the tour `id` in the URL path and the required `language` query parameter.

200.description: Tour availability, participant ranges, and add-ons

get.description:
## Overview

Retrieve normalized guest reviews and ratings for a specific tour.

## When to Use

- **Review sections** - Display guest feedback on tour detail pages
- **Trust building** - Show authentic ratings before booking
- **Decision support** - Help users evaluate tours before selecting dates

## What You Get

- **Guest reviews** - Review text, ratings, and dates
- **Pagination** - `limit` and `offset` query parameters
- **Localized content** - Reviews in the requested language where available

## Quick Start

Provide the tour `id` in the URL path plus required `language` and `currency` query parameters.

items.subject: Amazing experience
items.comment: Our guide was fantastic and skip-the-line saved us hours.

post.description:
## Overview

Resolve priced booking options, time slots, and required guest inputs for a selected tour date and participant mix.

## When to Use

- **Option/slot pickers** - Show available variants and start times for a date
- **Live pricing** - Display authoritative slot sell totals (`pricing.totals.net` / `priceSummary.netPrice`)
- **Checkout forms** - Collect `bookingQuestionSchema` before proceeding to payment

## What You Get

- **Booking options** - `optionId`, title, and `bookingQuestionSchema`
- **Time slots** - `dateTime`, `isAvailable`, and slot-level pricing (`unitNet` / `totalNet` / `totals.net` / `priceSummary.netPrice`, plus `totals.commission` when markup applies)
- **Participant mapping** - Uses `ticketCategory` keys from availability (e.g. `adult`, `child`)

## Money semantics

Field names keep `*Net` from experiences-api; dispatcher marks commercial net up **in place** to partner sell. Use `slots[].pricing.totals.net` as `selection.price.amount` on prebook.

## Quick Start

POST a body with `language`, `currency`, `date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`), and `participants` to `/experiences/tours/{id}/booking-options`. Use slot `pricing.totals.net` for display and checkout handoff.

## Option-level `price`

`options[].price.amount` is overwritten from the lowest available slot `pricing.totals.net` for the requested mix (after markup). It is not the GYG catalog from-price. Checkout still uses the chosen slot `pricing.totals.net`.

## Overview

Create a temporary hold on the selected tour slot and a Stripe PaymentIntent for checkout.

## When to Use

- **Checkout start** — After the user picks option, slot, and participants from booking-options
- **Payment setup** — Obtain `transactionId` and `secretKey` for Stripe SDK confirmation
- **Hold window** — Reserve inventory for ~10 minutes before book

## What You Get

- **Checkout context** — `tourId`, `optionId`, `dateTime`, `language`, `participants`, and pricing echoed back
- **Provider refs** — `cartId`, `experienceBookingId`, `providerBookingId`, `status`, `reservationExpiresAt`
- **Stripe fields** — `transactionId`, `secretKey`, `paymentTypes: ["TRANSACTION_ID"]`

## Quick Start

POST the same `selection` used for display pricing from booking-options with `usePaymentSdk: true`. Confirm payment with Stripe, then call `POST /experiences/bookings`.

200.description: Prebook created with selection context, validate refs, and Stripe checkout fields

post.description:
Capture Stripe payment then confirm cart with experiences-api. Cart status `completed` maps to dispatcher `PENDING_CONFIRMATION`; final `CONFIRMED` arrives via webhook. Cart status `ERROR` returns 502.

Public booking responses expose partner **sell** in `price` and partner earn in `commission` / `clientCommission`. Provider retail / invoice (`providerPayment`) is omitted.

Public response omits `providerPayment` (provider retail/invoice).

get.description:
## Overview

Preview the refund amount and cancellation fee for a booking before committing to cancel it.

## When to Use

- **Cancellation confirmation screens** - Show the guest exactly what they'll be refunded
- **Support tooling** - Check whether a booking is still cancellable before offering a refund

## What You Get

- **`cancellable`** - Whether the booking can currently be cancelled
- **`policy`** - `cancellationFee`, `refundAmount`, `refundType`, `estimateConfidence`, `currency`, `sellingPrice`

## Quick Start

GET this endpoint with the dispatcher `bookingId` from `POST /experiences/bookings`. This does not cancel the booking - call `POST /experiences/bookings/{bookingId}/cancel` to actually cancel.

parameters.name: bookingId
parameters.description: Dispatcher booking ID returned from POST /experiences/bookings

post.description:
## Overview

Cancel a confirmed experience booking and trigger any applicable refund.

## When to Use

- **Guest-initiated cancellation** - After the guest confirms via the cancel-preview screen

## What You Get

- **`status`** - Dispatcher-level booking status after cancellation
- **`providerStatus`** - Raw upstream provider status, when available
- **`refund`** - Present when a refund was calculated; `refundPending` indicates it hasn't settled yet

## Quick Start

POST with the dispatcher `bookingId` from `POST /experiences/bookings`. Call `GET /experiences/bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-preview` first to show the guest the refund amount.
